mapper.insert: INSERT INTO candidate_return_results ( meeting_id, candidate_id, participant_id, calculation_version, return_minutes, transfer_count, last_train_departure_at, last_train_arrival_at, last_safe_departure_at, can_return ) VALUES ( #{meetingId}, #{candidateId}, #{participantId}, #{calculationVersion}, #{returnMinutes}, #{transferCount}, #{lastTrainDepartureAt}, #{lastTrainArrivalAt}, #{lastSafeDepartureAt}, #{canReturn} )
mapper.select:
SELECT crr.result_id AS resultId, crr.meeting_id AS meetingId, crr.candidate_id AS candidateId, crr.participant_id AS participantId,
u.nickname AS nickname,
crr.calculation_version AS calculationVersion, crr.return_minutes AS returnMinutes, crr.transfer_count AS transferCount, crr.last_train_departure_at AS lastTrainDepartureAt, crr.last_train_arrival_at AS lastTrainArrivalAt, crr.last_safe_departure_at AS lastSafeDepartureAt, crr.can_return AS canReturn, crr.calculated_at AS calculatedAt
FROM candidate_return_results crr
JOIN meeting_participants mp ON mp.participant_id = crr.participant_id
JOIN users u ON u.user_id = mp.user_id
WHERE crr.candidate_id = #{candidateId}
ORDER BY crr.participant_id ASC

SELECT crr.result_id AS resultId, crr.meeting_id AS meetingId, crr.candidate_id AS candidateId, crr.participant_id AS participantId,
u.nickname AS nickname,
crr.calculation_version AS calculationVersion, crr.return_minutes AS returnMinutes, crr.transfer_count AS transferCount, crr.last_train_departure_at AS lastTrainDepartureAt, crr.last_train_arrival_at AS lastTrainArrivalAt, crr.last_safe_departure_at AS lastSafeDepartureAt, crr.can_return AS canReturn, crr.calculated_at AS calculatedAt
FROM candidate_return_results crr
JOIN meeting_participants mp ON mp.participant_id = crr.participant_id
JOIN users u ON u.user_id = mp.user_id
WHERE crr.candidate_id = #{candidateId} AND crr.calculation_version = #{calculationVersion}
ORDER BY crr.participant_id ASC

SELECT result_id, meeting_id, candidate_id, participant_id, calculation_version, return_minutes, transfer_count, last_train_departure_at, last_train_arrival_at, last_safe_departure_at, can_return, calculated_at FROM candidate_return_results WHERE candidate_id = #{candidateId} AND participant_id = #{participantId} AND calculation_version = #{calculationVersion} LIMIT 1
